title: docs(skills): the end state after create-objectstack installs @objectstack/skills — one pinned --copy spelling, one next.0 exception, and the 17.x to 18 skills step (#23275)
body:
Fixes #23275

Clause-②: no (docs)

PR #23248 made `create-objectstack` install the skills catalog itself: the scaffolded `package.json` depends on `@objectstack/skills` at the `@objectstack/spec` version, and the scaffolder runs `npx -y skills@1.7.2 experimental_sync --agent claude-code --copy -y`. The six pages still described the scaffolder from before that PR, and they taught a different, linked sync. This PR rewrites them to the end state. There is now one install spelling on the site, the scaffolder's own. The one scaffolder that still read `main` (`18.0.0-next.0`) is named in one sentence, in one place. The upgrade guide and the v18 line page gain the 17.x to 18 skills step.

## What changes, page by page

- `content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx`, "Installing skills" (outside the generated block, which is byte-identical):
  - Step 2 is now `npx skills@1.7.2 experimental_sync --agent claude-code --copy -y` ("copy it from node_modules"). Step 1 is unchanged.
  - The paragraph after the steps says the sync copies real files into `.claude/skills/SKILL` and nowhere else, and records them in `skills-lock.json`. It says to commit both and to keep `--copy`, because the links point into `node_modules`, which a clone does not have. It says why the CLI is pinned (the scaffolder runs the same version), and to use one runtime per run, never `--agent '*'`. The linked form is no longer taught.
  - "Updating" adds: commit what the sync changed.
  - "Which versions exist" now holds the one exception sentence: `create-objectstack@18.0.0-next.0` still installed the skills from `main` with `skills add`, and step 2 skips those. So in such a project, run `npx skills remove --all` (or remove the skills by name, as the upgrade step does), then steps 1 and 2. The paragraph also links the 17.x line to the new upgrade step.
  - "New projects" now describes the end state: the scaffolder runs both steps (the dependency is at the spec's version, the install puts it in `node_modules`, and the sync copies it into `.claude/skills/`), and its summary prints step 2 again. The "Through `18.0.0-next.0` …" paragraph is gone.
- `content/docs/ai/skills.mdx`: the same two commands. A sentence on real files, committing them and keeping `--copy`. The pointer to the reference now names the one scaffolder that is an exception.
- `content/docs/getting-started/build-with-claude-code.mdx`: the step-1 bullet now says the bundle comes from `@objectstack/skills` at your spec's version, copied once into `.claude/skills/` to commit, and links the exception. It no longer carries a "replace it" instruction. "Keep the skills current" uses the pinned `--copy` sync and says to commit the result.
- `content/docs/getting-started/your-first-project.mdx`: scaffold step 3 and the section 7 sentence get the same two edits ("once it comes from the package" is gone).
- `content/docs/upgrading.mdx`, "Moving the dependency pins": three steps become four. Step 4 says the catalog moves only with the other `@objectstack/*` packages, then re-run the pinned `--copy` sync and commit. Its "From 17.x to 18" half gives the remove, install and sync sequence.
- `content/docs/releases/v18/index.mdx`: one new bullet, "The AI skills move with the packages". It has the same rule and the same three-command block, and links to upgrading step 4.

`content/docs/releases/` is release-owned. This PR is docs-only (no code, no package), and the card and its claim name this page, so it does not ride a code change. The page is the hand-written status page of the v18 line, not compiled release notes.

## Where this differs from the card's literal text, and why (all measured)

1. **The remove list has 11 names, not 10. `objectstack-pm-dispatch` is added.** Through the contents API I listed `skills/` on `main` every two days from 2026-06-01 to 2026-10-13. Across those samples the catalog held 11 skill names. `objectstack-pm-dispatch` was on `main` from the 2026-08-02 sample to the last one before 2026-09-11. It is in the `@objectstack/spec@17.0.0` through `17.4.0` tags and gone from `17.5.0` on. The 17.x scaffolders read `main` at scaffold time, so projects scaffolded in that window got it. I installed a project from the `17.4.0` tree with the 17.0–17.3 scaffolders' `skills add … --all`. The card's 10-name `npx skills remove … -y` printed `Found 11 unique installed skill(s)` and `Successfully removed 10 skill(s)`. That left `objectstack-pm-dispatch` in `.claude/skills/`, `.agents/skills/` and `agent/skills/`, plus its `github` lock entry. The 11-name list removed all 11. A name that is not installed is skipped: on a 10-skill project the 11-name list printed `removed 10`, exit 0. So one list covers both project shapes, and the pages say so.
2. **The named remove carries `-y`.** `skills remove --help` lists `-y, --yes  Skip confirmation prompts` (and `--all … (-y implied)`). The scaffolder's own remedy line is `npx skills remove NAME -y` (`src/index.ts`). This container's CLI printed `Agent detected — removing non-interactively`, so a human at a terminal would get the prompt that `-y` skips.
3. **`remove` stays unpinned, as the card and the scaffolder's remedy spell it.** Only `experimental_sync` is pinned (`SKILLS_CLI = 'skills@1.7.2'` in `packages/create-objectstack/src/skills-install.ts` at this head), because that is the unstable interface. `npm view skills dist-tags` today gives `latest: 1.7.2`.

No other wording of the card's sequence changed. The 17.x to 18 step is the removal, then step 1, then step 2, plus the rule that the catalog moves only with the packages.

## Measured on 2026-10-13, in throwaway projects under the session scratchpad

Node 22.22.0, npm 10.9.4, skills CLI 1.7.2. Every exit code was captured before any pipe.

- **Registry.** `@objectstack/skills` dist-tags `latest` and `next` are both `18.0.0-next.0`; its versions are `0.0.0-stage` and `18.0.0-next.0`. `@objectstack/spec` and `create-objectstack` are at `latest 17.7.0` and `next 18.0.0-next.0`, so no scaffolder with #23248 has been published yet. I read the published tarballs' `dist/index.js`. `17.0.0` and `17.3.0` run `skills add objectstack-ai/objectstack/skills --all`. `17.5.0`, `17.7.0` and `18.0.0-next.0` run `skills add objectstack-ai/objectstack/skills --skill '*' --agent AGENT -y`. So `18.0.0-next.0` is the one 18.x scaffolder that reads `main`, and the pages describe every scaffolder publish after it.
- **This tree's scaffolder, run for real.** I ran `tsx packages/create-objectstack/src/index.ts real-probe` with no flags, so its own `pnpm install` went to the registry. Results:
  - The install printed `+ @objectstack/skills 18.0.0-next.0`, then `Installing AI skills for your coding agent from @objectstack/skills@18.0.0-next.0...` and `Synced 10 skills`.
  - `.claude/skills/` holds 10 directories, 10 real `SKILL.md` and 0 symlinks. `skills-lock.json` has 10 entries, all `source @objectstack/skills`, `sourceType node_modules`, `version 18.0.0-next.0`. `package.json` has `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/skills` both at `^18.0.0-next.0`.
  - The summary prints `npx skills@1.7.2 experimental_sync --agent claude-code --copy -y`.
  - `git add -A` staged 10 `SKILL.md` and 0 symlinks, and a clone held 10 readable `SKILL.md`. The control was the linked sync (no `--copy`) on a copy of that project: it staged 20 symlinks and 0 `SKILL.md`, and its clone held 0 readable `SKILL.md` and 20 dangling links. This matches #23248's committed-project measurement.
- **The reference's two steps, on a fresh `@objectstack/spec@next` project.** I extracted the code block from the page and ran it with `bash -e`: exit 0. It saved `@objectstack/skills ^18.0.0-next.0` and wrote 10 real skills in `.claude/skills/`, with a lock of 10 entries, all `node_modules`. On a `17.7.0` project, step 1 exits 1 with `npm error code ETARGET` and `No matching version found for @objectstack/skills@17.7.0`. That is the reference's "Which versions exist" line, unchanged.
- **The 17.x to 18 step, both 17.x project shapes.**
  - **Shape A** is what the 17.5–17.7 scaffolders write: `skills add … --skill '*' --agent claude-code -y` from `main`, 10 real skills and a lock of 10 × `github`.
  - **Shape B** is what the 17.0–17.3 scaffolders write: `skills add … --all` over the `17.4.0` tree. It gives `.claude/skills/` 11 symlinks, `.agents/skills/` and `agent/skills/` 11 real copies each, and a lock of 11 × `github`.
  - **Control.** On shape A, after bumping to `@objectstack/spec@next`, running step 1 and then the sync with no removal printed `Skipped NAME from @objectstack/skills: installed with \`skills add\` from objectstack-ai/objectstack` × 10 and `Nothing to sync.`, exit 0. The tree was unchanged. This is the card's premise, reproduced.
  - **The page's exact block**, taken from `upgrading.mdx` and de-indented, ran under `bash -e` after the bump on both shapes, exit 0:
    - A: `removed 10`, `Synced 10 skills`.
    - B: `Found 11`, `removed 11`, `Synced 10 skills`.
    - On both: `.claude/skills/` has 10 real `SKILL.md` and 0 symlinks, and the lock has 10 × `@objectstack/skills` / `node_modules` / `18.0.0-next.0`. A `diff -r` of B's `.claude/skills` against `node_modules/@objectstack/skills/dist/skills` differs only by the catalog `README.md`. On B the `.agents/skills/` and `agent/skills/` directories remain, empty (git tracks no empty directory).
  - The `upgrading.mdx` block and the `releases/v18/index.mdx` block are byte-identical once de-indented.
- **One spelling.** `git grep -ho` for every `npx … experimental_sync …` under `content/docs`, excluding `releases/v17`, returns 7 occurrences, all `npx skills@1.7.2 experimental_sync --agent claude-code --copy -y`, and 0 of any other form. That equals `skillsInstallHint('claude-code')` and the line in the scaffold's `AGENTS.md` and `README.md`.

## Gates, at `98ee767b5a`

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, with no paths, derived 50 commands from the merge base: 6 paths, 119 changed lines.
- First pass: 45 exited 0. Four exited 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, read as not measured): `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-security-posture`, `check:skill-examples` and `check:docs-transcript-drift`. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:docs` exited 1 with "Generate it first: pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:schema". That is a missing gitignored tree, not a finding about the docs.
- I then ran `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/spec --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint --filter=@objectstack/client --filter=@objectstack/client-react --concurrency=2` under the shared verify lock: 35 tasks, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. All five re-ran to exit 0: "263 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)", "226 generated files in sync with packages/spec", "4 declared transcript value(s) across 414 page(s) … equal what the registry derives today". The tree was clean after the build.
- `--ran` over the final per-command record: `50 derived, 50 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN` ("a DERIVED zero").
- The card's named gates are among the 50 and exit 0: `check:corpus-claim-drift`, `check:doc-authoring`, and `check-doc-route-spelling.mjs --advisory` plus `--self-test`. Enforce mode (no flag) also exits 0: `population clean`. `check:doc-anchors` exits 0, and it is the gate that resolves the new `/docs/upgrading#moving-the-dependency-pins` links.
- Docs link check, as `check-links.yml` runs it: `lychee 0.24.2 --offline --root-dir content --fallback-extensions mdx,md --config lychee.toml` over `content/**/*.md`, `content/**/*.mdx`, `README.md` and `ARCHITECTURE.md`. Exit 0: `2457 Total … 0 Errors`.
- MDX compile of the six pages with the workspace's `@mdx-js/mdx` 3.1.1: 6 of 6 ok. A negative control (a bare unclosed tag) fails to compile.
- `pnpm lint` is not affected. Measured: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the six files gives 6 results, 0 errors, each `File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied`. `eslint.config.mjs` enables no type-aware linting, so this diff cannot move any other file's verdict.
- A control-character grep (`-naP` over the C0 range and DEL) on the six files has no hits, and `check:nul-bytes` exits 0.
- `skip-changeset`: the diff is `content/docs/**` only, which ships in no package.

## Acceptance notes

- `npm create objectstack@latest`, which these pages use, resolves `create-objectstack@17.7.0` today (`latest`), and that scaffolder still runs `skills add` from `main`. The pages on `main` describe the v18 line. The 17.x line is covered by "Which versions exist" (no 17.x catalog) and by the new upgrade step. This was already true before this PR and resolves at GA. Not filed.
- The `next` channel sentence (`npx skills add objectstack-ai/objectstack/skills --skill '*' --agent claude-code -y`) is kept as is, per ruling A.
- The two package READMEs and the `objectstack-upgrade` skill belong to the skills lane's sibling card (`skills/**` and `packages/**` are outside this claim). If that card copies the card's remove list, it needs `objectstack-pm-dispatch` too (finding 1 above).
